title: Remote Desktop cannot connect to office PC
content:
Problem: Remote Desktop cannot connect to office PC on Ubuntu. I already restarted the device once.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Enabled the approved RDP rule and verified the device was reachable.

title: Remote access VPN drops after login
content:
Problem: Remote access VPN drops after login on Ubuntu. The issue happens repeatedly.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Updated the VPN client and re-created the connection profile.

title: Windows cannot find network printer
content:
Problem: Windows cannot find network printer on macOS. Please help because I need this for work.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Cleared the print queue and reinstalled the approved printer driver.

title: RDP Credential Repair - Guide 1
content: Remove saved Remote Desktop credentials and reconnect using the current organization account.

title: Company VPN connects then immediately disconnects
content:
Problem: Company VPN connects then immediately disconnects on Windows 10. It happens on my work laptop.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Updated the VPN client and re-created the connection profile.
